key.name: modules-media
key.description: What is playing, from any MPRIS player, with its tab.

key.name: media-compact-on-hover
key.description: The pill grows into the track, its buttons and position.

key.name: modules-notification
key.description: Notifications in the pill, with their own buttons.

key.name: notification-replace-banners
key.description: Off, GNOME shows its own.

key.name: modules-hud
key.description: Volume, brightness and lock keys in the pill, instead of GNOME's popup.

key.name: hud-replace-osd
key.description: Off, GNOME shows its own.

key.name: modules-home
key.description: The blocks of the Home tab.

key.name: modules-progress
key.description: File copies and downloads, with the Transfers tab.

key.name: progress-folders
key.description: Browser downloads show from your Downloads folder and from these, up to 10. Folders inside them are not watched.

key.name: modules-timer
key.description: Timers in the pill, with the Timer tab.

key.name: modules-greeting
key.description: Bu says hello the first time, and what is new after an update.

key.name: greeting-intro-shown
key.description: Bookkeeping: Bu introduced himself once; About sets it false to show it again.

key.name: greeting-version-seen
key.description: Bookkeeping: the last version What's new spoke for.

key.name: prefs-page
key.description: Bookkeeping: the page prefs opens on, then clears (whats-new).

key.name: modules-calendar
key.description: Today and the week ahead in the Calendar tab, and the next event as an idle plan.

key.name: modules-input
key.description: A short flash when you switch input source or input method.

key.name: input-replace-switcher
key.description: Off, holding Super+Space shows GNOME's list.

key.name: modules-agent
key.description: Your Claude Code sessions in the pill, and their permission prompts.

key.name: agent-quiet-focused
key.description: While its terminal is focused, a session's pill does not open on its own.

key.name: modules-copied
key.description: A short flash of what you copied.

key.name: copied-show-preview
key.description: The text, the file names or a thumbnail of the image. Off, the pill only says Copied and the clipboard is not read.

key.name: modules-clipboard
key.description: The Clipboard tab, in the strip's slot unless another is chosen.

key.name: modules-clock
key.description: A second clock in the idle pill, with the part of the day.

key.name: modules-weather
key.description: The condition and temperature where you are.

key.name: idle-content
key.description: Automatic shows what matters now; Nothing keeps only the light.

key.name: idle-calendar-all-day
key.description: Shown when nothing with a time is left today.

key.name: idle-auto-plans
key.description: The idle plans Automatic may show, in the order that breaks a tie.

key.name: idle-auto-interval
key.description: Minutes between turns when plans matter equally.

key.name: idle-clock-style
key.description: The time follows Date & Time.

key.name: idle-weather-automatic
key.description: Where you are, with Location Services on. Off, the city below.

key.name: idle-weather-refresh
key.description: Asked only while the pill shows the weather.

key.name: apps-hidden
key.description: Apps whose activities never show. Any id an app goes by; it is slugged.

key.name: apps-plain
key.description: Apps drawn by the default adapter instead of their own.

key.name: tabs-pinned
key.description: Standalone tabs shown in the strip all the time, besides the slot.

key.name: tabs-slot
key.summary: Standalone tab in the strip's slot
key.description: Set by choosing a tab from ⋯. Empty or not enabled: the first enabled standalone tab.

key.name: expanded-width
key.description: 0 fits it to the monitor.

key.name: dev-mode
key.description: Lets Looking Glass reload one module without restarting the Shell.

key.name: keybind-focus
key.description: ←/→ move · Enter opens · Esc lets go

key.name: daypart-starts
key.description: Start hours of dawn, morning, noon, afternoon, evening and night, 0–23, in that order; one part wraps past midnight. Anything else uses the defaults.

key.name: activity-linger
key.description: Paused or done pills, and unanswered asks.

key.name: mascot-rest-after
key.description: Seconds without input before Bu holds still.

key.name: cluster-background
key.description: Behind the left and right clusters.

key.name: cluster-contrast
key.description: Automatic follows the wallpaper, not the style.

key.name: left-cluster-empty
key.description: Left cluster, on the desktop and in the Overview.

key.name: clock-defaults-applied
key.description: Set after the first enable gave GNOME's clock Buoy's defaults (the time alone, 24-hour) on the keys the user had not set.

key.name: weather-defaults-applied
key.description: Set after the first enable gave GNOME Weather's units °C and km/h where the user had not chosen them.

key.name: dock-defaults-applied
key.description: Set after the first enable gave Ubuntu's dock Buoy's defaults (at the bottom, hiding, 32 px, primary display only) on the keys the user had not set.

key.name: cluster-radius
key.description: 16 is a pill, like the island.

key.name: cluster-opacity
key.description: How strong the background is. 17 matches a top bar button's hover; with a menu open it is a little stronger, as GNOME's.

key.name: window-corners
key.description: Like a floating window's, with the wallpaper behind them. The bottom stays square.

key.name: window-corners-radius
key.description: 15 is a floating window's.
